name: eqho
description: Free, offline voice-to-text dictation. Press a hotkey, speak, text appears - 100% local, powered by Whisper.

paragraphs: Speak anywhere Windows lets you type. Press a hotkey, talk, and your words appear in whatever app is focused — Word, your browser, Slack, code editors, anything. Powered by OpenAI's Whisper (via faster-whisper and whisper.cpp), running 100% on your machine — much faster with a graphics card (NVIDIA, AMD or Intel on Windows), and it works on any other PC too (using the processor).
features: 🔒 Private by design — no cloud, no account, no API key. Your voice never leaves your computer.

⚡ Works on any PC — on Windows, NVIDIA cards (CUDA) and AMD or Intel graphics cards (Vulkan) make transcription fast. Laptops with only built-in graphics, and AMD/Intel PCs on Linux and macOS, run on the processor…
🆓 Free and open source — no subscription, no word limits, ever.
🌍 13 languages — English-optimized by default, multilingual models one click away.
Dictation into any application via clipboard paste or simulated typing
